title: Search for a proof goal by goal
when: a goal that needs a few steps (intro, cases, a lemma, then a decision procedure) and where you can name candidate tactics or lemmas
trying many cheap tactics at every step of a proof, without writing the whole proof
whenNot: a goal one tactic closes: prove_auto is cheaper
the final proof: the search returns tactics; put them in your file and check it with lean_check

header.description: Imports, opens and definitions the statement needs; import Mathlib when not given

tactics.description: Tactics you propose, best first; tried at every state in that order. Their ranking is yours: the search keeps it

lemmas.description: Names of lemmas to try with exact and apply

nodes.description: The most tactics to try, 60 when not given

maxDepth.description: The deepest state expanded, 12 when not given

timeoutSec.description: Seconds the whole search may take, 180 when not given; a tactic gets at most 20 s of it

alpha.description: Length normalisation of the node score (score / depth^alpha); drawn from the seed when not given

script.description: The tactics, one per line, each acting on the first goal

trace.description: The last tactics tried, with how each ended

implementations.description: Best-first search over Pantograph's goal states (the implementation of lean.goals, with the same settings), with the battery's tactics and the model's as candidates. Not run against a real Pantograph; measured against whole-proof sessions at equal dollars and removed if it loses (plan change PC6 item 3).
